build_yolov3_detector: build a YOLOV3 single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head modules
run_yolov3_loss: run the YOLOV3 loss computation on a batch of input images and ground truth data samples
run_yolov3_predict: run YOLOV3 prediction on input images to get bounding boxes, labels, and classification scores
run_yolov3_extract_feat: run feature extraction through the YOLOV3 backbone and neck on a batch of input images
review_yolov3_init: review the YOLOV3 constructor to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization parameters
